scope: Wave 4 Statistics, Legislation, Integrity, Featured Reports, Public Records, Search and their canonical cross-links.

basis: Canonical relationship modules validate stored relationships and throw when either endpoint cannot be resolved.
App routes and required section/record anchors used by Wave 4 canonical destinations are present.
Wave 4 dense tables are horizontally scrollable rather than forcing page-width overflow.
Global focus-visible, reduced-motion, form-control and skip-link accessibility baselines are present.

liveBrowserAudit.reason: The connected Vercel deployment fetch was denied for this project, and the public web fetcher could not access bettermakati.org routes during this audit.
liveBrowserAudit.implication: No claim is made here about rendered viewport screenshots, runtime console state, visual focus order or production PDF embedding.

continuousIntegration.blocker: Existing BetterBarangay Place Registry guard in check:barangays expects a specific /civic-map/ link marker and stops the quality pipeline before the new Wave 4 checks run.
continuousIntegration.wave4Attribution: The blocker predates W4-5i and is outside this workstream.

fixesApplied.finding: Legislation filter buttons, year selector and View record toggle did not explicitly meet the site-wide 44px touch-target baseline.
fixesApplied.fix: Added min-h-11 to the interactive controls.

fixesApplied.finding: Inline Featured Report record citations used legacy generic hrefs even when the Civic Intelligence resolver knew a more precise canonical destination.
fixesApplied.fix: ReportArticle now resolves typed record references through reportCivicNodeResolver/reportRecordRefToCivicRef before falling back to the stored href.

fixesApplied.finding: Integrity supplier destinations contained ?view=suppliers even though Integrity does not parse that query parameter.
fixesApplied.fix: Canonical supplier destination is now /integrity#procurement in relationship resolvers and global Search.

checks: supported typed Integrity and ecosystem references
source-backed edges require source IDs and a statement

verified: GDP indicators -> curated BetterGov continuation/comparison resources
report analysis backlinks are derived from the report-owned graph
antiInference: no individual place attribution from aggregate indicators
no service/project/accountability attribution without explicit evidence

verified: service backlinks retain the historical-effect caveat
future City Monitor/Public Records edges require explicit canonical IDs or exact shared source URLs
validated internal Integrity provenance graph projects to shared Civic Intelligence references
procurement/audit records link to canonical Accountability records
Public Records identity uses exact source URL equality
BetterGov procurement links remain continuation context rather than Makati-specific evidence
antiInference: no location-string to Place Registry inference
no duplicate project identity for Accountability-owned procurement entries
no risk score, red-flag, inferred ownership/conflict or wrongdoing label

verified: one report-owned relationship per unique typed canonical evidence reference
report -> record relationship kind is synthesizes, never evidence-for
Statistics, Accountability and Integrity derive reverse analysis backlinks
inline evidence now uses canonical resolver destinations
Wave 4 source registries merge by exact URL
one source can retain multiple BetterMakati contexts
Reports, Integrity and seed Legislation records link back to matching Public Records entries by exact URL

surfaceChecks.statistics: Single dense table uses min-width inside overflow-x-auto; section navigation and source actions use mobile-sized targets.
surfaceChecks.legislation: Search/filter controls are labelled; filters and View record toggle now explicitly use min-h-11.
surfaceChecks.integrity: Both dense evidence tables use overflow-x-auto; view controls use min-h-11 and aria-pressed.
surfaceChecks.reports: Report tables use overflow-x-auto; evidence tokens wrap; page has one content heading per rendered branch.
surfaceChecks.publicRecords: Filters are labelled; primary actions use shared 44px button classes.
surfaceChecks.publicRecordDetail: PDF iframe has an accessible title and original-source fallback.

path: official attached source / Public Records entry
Public Records source when exact URL matches
Featured Report analysis when typed evidence references the finding
Statistics / Integrity / Report destination or lazy Legislation record
BetterGov/BetterLGU only as external handoffs when appropriate
